Name: A White Wizard
Author: Yingliyi
Description:
[size=4]某天，醍醐镇来了一名魔法师，同样是法师，他却和煤炭森林里那位截然不同，你们会发展出怎样的故事呢？他会成为你的同伴？好友？亦或者是......伴侣？
[/size]网页翻译可能会导致简介的字全变红色且字号最大或排版错误的bug，把自动翻译关掉即可变回正常。
我的小红书uid：6882574530

[center][color=#6d9eeb][size=5][b]MOD内容﻿[/b]
[/size][/color][size=4]1.三个NPC，暂时只有两个可婚。
2.农作物家具和武器。
3.一个新的商店。
4.每位NPC都会有8、9个好感事件，目前只有一名已完成。以及6个主线事件。[/size]

[color=#76a5af][b][size=4]﻿[/size][size=5]注意事项
[/size][/b][/color][color=#e06666][size=6]1.本mod为乙女向，玩家默认女性，无任何LGBT内容，禁腐！！[/size][/color]
[size=4]2.本mod目前共有三名NPC，但有完整内容且可攻略的角色只有一位，其余角色正在制作中。﻿所有男主都洁。[/size]
[size=4]请勿与其余未制作完成的npc结婚！很可能会爆红。[/size]
[size=4]3.本mod含部分AI音乐，其余音乐来自b站黑耀耀。如果厌恶AI音乐的人多我会增加是否开启AI音乐的选项。[/size]
[size=4]4.本mod绝大部分内容由作者一人制作，部分CG为呃呃eee呃呃呃呃绘制，感谢大佬在美术方面的帮助！（作者画的很难看，不要骂了已经在努力学习了TT）[/size]
[size=4]5.遇到bug或有任何建议都可在评论区反馈。由于制作时间跨度较大，所以可能存在设定不一的情况，如遇到可联系我修改。[/size]
[size=4]6.本mod含角色个人线和主线，相关攻略在文件内。但是主线只写了一点点......👉👈[/size]
[size=4]7.两张地图为溱羽的模板修改，代码来自三生的模板。[/size]

[color=#93c47d][size=5][b]兼容[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]与SVE，七大罪，夜城，东斯卡普，阳莓村等多数mod兼容。
[/size]

[size=5]I'm really sorry for not including an English version! My English proficiency is almost skeletal, and the lack of i18n files has made translation even more challenging. I’d be truly grateful if someone could help provide a translation. Until then, I might resort to using AI for translation, though I’ve noticed that quite a few people seem averse to machine-translated content, which makes me hesitant to go that route.[/size]

[size=4]One day, a mage arrived in Dihu Town. Though also a practitioner of magic, he was completely different from the one in the Coal Forest. What kind of story will unfold between you? Will he become your companion? A close friend? Or perhaps... a partner?[/size]
[size=4]⚠️ Important Notes:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]This mod is otome-oriented. The player character is set as female by default, with no LGBT content. No BL/fujoshi content allowed!!

[*]The mod currently features three NPCs, but only one has complete content and is available for romance. The other characters are still in development. All male leads are "pure" (chaste/faithful).

[*]This mod includes AI-generated music. If many players dislike the AI music, I will add an option to turn it off (disabling all music, as I don’t know how to compose).

[*]The vast majority of this mod’s content was created by the author. Except for the music, there is no AI-generated content. Some CGs were drawn by [呃呃eee呃呃呃呃呃]—big thanks to this master for their help with the artwork! (The author’s own drawings are not great, please don’t criticize—I’m already working hard to improve TT)

[*]If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please leave feedback in the comments section.

[*]This mod includes both character-specific routes and a main storyline. Guides are available within the files.

[*]The two maps were modified from templates by 溱羽, and the code uses templates from 三生. Many thanks to 溱羽 and 三生 for their help with the maps and code!

[/list][size=5]Wishing everyone a joyful gaming experience![/size]
[i]Translated by DeepSeek[/i]

[/list]
